verdict.rationale: HeyGen's docs describe operating the product through natural language. The Video Agent creates videos from a text prompt, accepts follow-up messages, and revises scenes you name. Users can also prompt from Slack or from any MCP-compatible agent, and an assistant maps a plain-language description of the work to endpoints. Missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that the natural-language control works as claimed, and evidence of natural-language control beyond video creation and editing (e.g., account or workspace management).

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can operate the product with natural-language commands

citations.quote: Create videos from a text prompt with full control over avatar, voice, style, and file inputs.
Review storyboards, send follow-up messages, and iterate with the Video Agent before generating.
Revise only the scenes you name in a Video Agent video
Generate HeyGen videos from Slack — connect, prompt, and share.
Connect HeyGen video generation to any MCP-compatible AI agent — no API keys, no local server, no separate credits.
Describe the work and the assistant maps it to the endpoints that automate it — before you write a line of code.
